class.name: MaszynaMoverCoupling
class.brief_description: The core's coupling flags as the Mover's [code]coupling::[/code] bits, and back.
class.description: The one mapping between [enum RailVehicleController.CouplingFlags] and the Mover's [code]coupling::[/code] bits ([code]MOVER.h:162-176[/code]), and between [enum RailVehicleController.CouplerEnd] and its [code]end::[/code]. MaSzyna's data writes its coupling numbers in the same bits - a FIZ's coupler masks, a [code].scn[/code]'s [code]couplingdata[/code], a scenario's [code]Shunt[/code] - so its readers take the flags from here too.

method.name: flags_from_mover
method.description: The core's flags of the Mover's bits; a bit that stands for no flag is left out ([method has_unknown_bits]).

method.name: flags_to_mover
method.description: The Mover's bits of the core's flags.

method.name: has_unknown_bits
method.description: Whether [param mover_flags] has a bit that stands for no coupling flag.
